items.function: Tracks the Charts, where status comes from.

items.name: Poster print, portrait 2:3
items.description: A full-size printed poster: a band, a club night, an advertisement off a hoarding.
items.function: What she looked at while the records played: taped up, pinned up, never framed.

items.name: Poster print, small 3:4
items.description: A small printed poster or flyer, the size that fits a cabinet side.
items.function: What she looked at while the records played: taped up, pinned up, never framed.

items.name: Poster print, landscape 3:2
items.description: A wide printed poster: a car, a motorcycle, a skyline somewhere else.
items.function: What she looked at while the records played: taped up, pinned up, never framed.

items.name: Floor mat, gaff-patched
items.description: A split rubber standing mat held together with strips of gaff tape.
items.function: Where she stands at the decks: warmer than concrete, kills the rumble.

items.name: Wiring diagram, pinned
items.description: A hand-drawn A3 signal-chain diagram pinned by the rig, annotated in two colours.
items.function: The signal chain that makes no commercial sense but works, written down.

items.name: Call-sign card
items.description: A cardboard panel with the station letters hand-painted in faded magenta.
items.function: The station’s only branding, taped above the rig.

items.name: Chart printout, pinned
items.description: A strip of tractor-feed paper with this week’s rankings, one line circled.
items.function: Where the station stands this week.

items.name: Dead guitar, leaning
items.description: A solid-body electric guitar from a ruin, strings gone slack, leaning in the corner.
items.function: None. It deserved a try; she kept it.

items.name: Coat hook rail
items.description: A plank with four bent steel hooks, screwed by the door.
items.function: Jacket, bag and the cage lamp, in reach of the bed and the door.

items.name: Extension cord reel
items.description: A red drum reel of heavy cord on a steel frame, four outlets on the side.
items.function: Carries the power spine to wherever the wall has none.

items.name: Sling bag, packed
items.description: Dark ripstop sling bag with a slotted front panel and a faded magenta patch, packed in order.
items.function: Staged by the door in packing order: cables, meter, jacks, tape sleeve.

items.name: Work boots
items.description: Her scuffed work boots, laces tucked in, toes to the door.
items.function: Staged with the bag: she can be out of the door in a minute.

items.name: Antenna relic
items.description: A bent rooftop yagi on a short mast, stood in an old tyre: the first array she ever pulled a signal from.
items.function: Too damaged to use, too important to throw away.

items.name: Binoculars
items.description: Big ex-navy observation binoculars on a surveyor’s tripod, the rubber armour cracked, the lens caps long gone.
items.function: Watching the city from the deck: the towers, the lit windows, the roofs across the street.

items.name: Steel bucket
items.description: A dented galvanised bucket with a rag hung over the rim.
items.function: Catches what the riser drips; carries whatever needs carrying.

items.name: Mirror cabinet
items.description: A dented steel wall cabinet with a mirror door, the silvering going at the corners.
items.function: Soap, a comb, the small things of a bathroom, behind a second mirror.

items.name: Boiler drum
items.description: A dented enamel boiler drum hung on the wall, fed from the riser, its pilot jewel still lit.
items.function: The one warm thing in the bathroom.

items.name: Right-angle flashlight
items.description: An L-shaped chest flashlight with a spring-steel clip and an incandescent bulb.
items.function: Clipped to her chest on extraction runs through dark floors.

items.name: Shower tray, rail and curtain (left-hand corner)
items.description: A square enamel tray in the corner, an L of chromed rail overhead, the vinyl curtain closed down one side and pushed half back along the other.
items.function: The shower. Stands in a corner: its back and its left side to the two walls.

items.name: Shower tray, rail and curtain (right-hand corner)
items.description: A square enamel tray in the corner, an L of chromed rail overhead, the vinyl curtain closed down one side and pushed half back along the other.
items.function: The shower. Stands in a corner: its back and its right side to the two walls.

items.name: Shower riser, head and mixer
items.description: A chromed riser pipe off a two-handle mixer, a wide shower head on a bent arm at the top, limescale on everything.
items.function: Hot and cold over the tray; the left handle sticks.

items.name: Basin on a pedestal
items.description: A heavy white basin on its pedestal, crazed glaze, one pillar tap with a cross handle.
items.function: Hands, face, the morning. The mirror hangs over it.

items.name: WC with a cistern
items.description: A close-coupled WC, the black seat up against a low cistern with a chromed lever.
items.function: A proper bathroom has one.

items.name: Wall mirror with a glass shelf
items.description: A plain mirror in a thin steel edge, the silvering creeping black from the corners, a narrow glass shelf under it.
items.function: The mirror on the wall over the basin, at eye height.

items.name: Towel rail with a towel
items.description: A chromed ladder rail on the wall, a thin cream towel folded over its top rung.
items.function: Where the towel dries; in reach of the shower.

items.name: Bath mat
items.description: A thin terry mat gone grey, two paler bands at the ends.
items.function: Something that is not concrete to step onto out of the shower.

items.name: Pedal bin
items.description: A small dented steel pedal bin, its lid ring bent so it never quite shuts.
items.function: Offcuts, tape ends, dust: what a tidy daemon throws away.

items.name: Wall tiles, full height
items.description: A field of big white tiles two metres up the wall, grout gone grey, a chromed trim along the top.
items.function: The wall of the shower corner: where the water goes.

items.name: Wall tiles, splashback
items.description: Two courses of white tiles behind a basin or a counter, a chromed trim on top.
items.function: Keeps the wall behind the tap dry.

items.name: Bathtub, tiled in wall to wall (ledge on the left)
items.description: An old enamel bath boxed in with tiles from wall to wall: a tiled ledge at one end where the pipes come up, a tiled shelf along the wall, a loose access panel in the front.
items.function: Bath and shower in one; the curtain closes it off.

items.name: Bathtub, tiled in wall to wall (ledge on the right)
items.description: An old enamel bath boxed in with tiles from wall to wall: a tiled ledge at one end where the pipes come up, a tiled shelf along the wall, a loose access panel in the front.
items.function: Bath and shower in one; the curtain closes it off.

items.name: Shower curtain rail, wall to wall
items.description: A chromed rod from wall to wall over the front of the bath, screwed into the tiles with two round flanges.
items.function: The curtain runs on it (src/bathroom: the rings slide).

items.name: Washing line across the bath
items.description: A white plastic cord strung over the bath between two eye hooks, sagging in the middle.
items.function: Where the small washing dries, dripping into the bath.

items.name: Bra on the line (Vibe)
items.description: A black sports bra with a magenta trim, pegged up by its straps.
items.function: Vibe’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Bra on the line (Mint)
items.description: A lilac bra with a white lace edge, pegged up by its straps.
items.function: Mint’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Knickers on the line (Vibe)
items.description: Magenta knickers with a black waistband, pegged up.
items.function: Vibe’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Knickers on the line (Mint)
items.description: Lilac knickers with a white waistband, pegged up.
items.function: Mint’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Knickers on the line (Mint)
items.description: Plain white knickers, a bit grey from the wash.
items.function: Mint’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Socks on the line (Vibe)
items.description: Black sports socks with a magenta band, pegged by the cuffs.
items.function: Vibe’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Socks on the line (Mint)
items.description: Fluffy lilac socks with white cuffs, pegged up.
items.function: Mint’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Black tights on the line (Vibe)
items.description: Black tights pegged at the waist, the legs hanging long, one with a ladder.
items.function: Vibe’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Towel over the line (Mint)
items.description: A lilac towel thrown over the line, a white stripe near the hem.
items.function: Mint’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Towel over the line (Vibe)
items.description: A black towel thrown over the line, a magenta stripe near the hem.
items.function: Vibe’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Towel over the edge (Mint)
items.description: A lilac towel left over the edge of the bath.
items.function: Mint’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Towel over the edge (Vibe)
items.description: A white towel gone grey, left over the edge.
items.function: Vibe’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Socks over the radiator (Vibe)
items.description: Two black socks drying over the radiator.
items.function: Vibe’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Socks over the radiator (Mint)
items.description: Two lilac socks drying over the radiator.
items.function: Mint’s, washed in the basin and pegged up to dry.

items.name: Knickers on the floor (Vibe)
items.description: Magenta knickers, dropped in a crumple.
items.function: Left where it came off: the laundry basket is full.

items.name: A sock on the floor (Vibe)
items.description: One black sock, inside out, its pair somewhere else.
items.function: Left where it came off: the laundry basket is full.

items.name: A bra on the floor (Mint)
items.description: A lilac bra dropped face down, the straps tangled.
items.function: Left where it came off: the laundry basket is full.

items.name: A sock on the floor (Mint)
items.description: One fluffy lilac sock.
items.function: Left where it came off: the laundry basket is full.

items.name: Column radiator
items.description: An old cast-iron column radiator painted cream more than once, hung on two wall brackets a hand off the floor, its two pipes coming up out of the floor, the valve stiff.
items.function: Warms the bathroom a little; socks dry on it.

items.name: Laundry basket, overflowing
items.description: A square lilac plastic basket heaped over the rim with two people’s washing, a crimson sleeve hanging out.
items.function: Nobody has done the wash this week.

items.name: Chrome wire rack
items.description: A narrow chromed wire rack, four shelves, gone a little rusty at the feet.
items.function: Where both of them keep their bottles, and the things that do not fit anywhere else.

items.name: Wooden crate shelf
items.description: A wooden crate on its side, screwed to the wall through its back: a shelf inside and one on top.
items.function: A shelf made of what was lying around.

items.name: Paper lantern on a cord
items.description: A round paper lantern hung from the old ceiling rose on a black cord, a warm bulb inside, one rib dented.
items.function: The warm light they put up when the sealed fitting went: softer at night, and nicer.

items.name: Toothbrush holder (Vibe)
items.description: A black holder with one magenta toothbrush and the toothpaste tube stuck in it.
items.function: Hers: by the basin, never where it was.

items.name: Toothbrush holder (Mint)
items.description: A lilac holder with two toothbrushes, a white one and a purple one.
items.function: Hers, and the spare.

items.name: Shampoo bottle
items.description: A tall white bottle with a plain label, the cap left open.
items.function: Whoever ran out last uses this one.

items.name: Shampoo bottle (Mint)
items.description: A lilac bottle with a white cap and a curly label.
items.function: Mint’s, the one that smells of something sweet.

items.name: Body wash (Vibe)
items.description: A black bottle with a magenta cap and a magenta band for a label.
items.function: Vibe’s, the sporty one.

items.name: Pump bottle
items.description: A round white lotion bottle with a pump top.
items.function: Hand cream, the pump half broken.

items.name: Three small bottles
items.description: Three small bottles of different heights, their caps in three colours.
items.function: Samples, oils, something for the hair.

items.name: Nail polish, five bottles
items.description: Five little bottles in a row: magenta, crimson, lilac, purple and black.
items.function: Both of them paint their nails; nobody puts the bottles away.

items.name: Perfume bottle
items.description: A square glass bottle with a magenta cap, nearly empty.
items.function: Vibe’s, for going out.

items.name: Deodorant can
items.description: A dented aerosol can with a black cap.
items.function: Sprayed on the way out of the door.

items.name: Jar of cotton balls
items.description: A glass jar full of cotton balls, a tin lid.
items.function: Makeup off, at two in the morning.

items.name: Jar of hair ties
items.description: A small jar of hair ties and clips in every colour.
items.function: Shared, and always empty when you need one.

items.name: Hair dryer with its cord
items.description: A lilac hair dryer stood on its handle, its white cord coiled beside it.
items.function: Mint’s; Vibe borrows it.

items.name: Hairbrush
items.description: A black paddle brush full of hair, lying where it was put down.
items.function: Vibe’s; Mint uses a comb.

items.name: Makeup bag
items.description: A lilac zip bag, too full to close.
items.function: Mint’s; most of it is on the shelf.

items.name: Makeup on a tray
items.description: A plastic tray of lipstick, mascara, a compact and an eyeshadow palette.
items.function: Whoever is going out first gets the mirror.

items.name: Razor
items.description: A magenta plastic razor, the blade not new.
items.function: Vibe’s; it lives on the edge of the bath.

items.name: Folded towels
items.description: Three folded towels: a lilac one, a white one, a black one on top.
items.function: The clean ones; the others are on the floor.

items.name: Soap on a holder
items.description: A cracked enamel soap holder with a worn bar of soap.
items.function: By the basin.

items.name: Toilet rolls
items.description: Three spare toilet rolls stacked in a pyramid.
items.function: The spares, for once.

items.name: Toilet brush in its holder
items.description: A white toilet brush in a white pot.
items.function: Beside the WC.

items.name: Bathroom scale
items.description: A cream bathroom scale with a little dial window, pushed against the wall.
items.function: Nobody believes it.

items.name: Kitchen base cabinet
items.description: A two-door base unit, enamel doors yellowed, a scarred wooden worktop on it.
items.function: The counter. What is in it is her business.

items.name: Kitchen sink unit
items.description: A base unit under a pressed steel top: one bowl, a ribbed drainer, a swan-neck tap with a rag hung over it.
items.function: The kitchen sink. Running water; nobody asks from where.

items.name: Kitchen wall cabinet
items.description: A two-door wall unit hung a little crooked, one hinge gone slack.
items.function: Shut. She keeps spare fuses and a tin of screws in it.

items.name: Fridge, small, round-shouldered
items.description: A short round-shouldered fridge in chipped cream enamel, two doors, long chromed pull handles, a compressor that knocks when it starts.
items.function: It hums. That is all that is known about it.

items.name: Microwave, dial timer
items.description: A beige box with a dark mesh window, a wide door bar and two mechanical dials: a clockwork timer and a power knob.
items.function: It works; the bell at the end of the timer is the loudest thing in the kitchen.

items.name: Kitchen table
items.description: A small laminate-topped table with a steel edge band and four tube legs, one shimmed with a folded card.
items.function: Somewhere to sit that is not the studio.

items.name: Kitchen chair
items.description: A tube-steel chair with a cracked red vinyl seat and back pad.
items.function: One for her, one for whoever turns up.

items.name: Wall clock
items.description: A round wall clock with a cream face and black hands, running four minutes slow.
items.function: The time between broadcasts.
